suite: Project Forge M1B1 AI Safety / Red Team
status: TO VALIDATE against the integrated M1B1 backend and client

final_spec: Every gameplay-consumed result passes Draft 2020-12 WeaponSpec JSON Schema validation.
Every enum is in the checked-in runtime allow-list and every numeric value is finite and within bounds.
PowerBudget is recomputed from repaired fields; actual total and displayed power_score are at most 100 and agree after documented rounding.
A strong capability receives a gameplay-effective compatible drawback or a deterministic stat/ability reduction.
Unknown fields, code, URLs, tool calls, callbacks, scene paths and provider control data never reach gameplay.
execution: Player text and provider output are data only: zero eval, script load, process/file access, tool invocation or provider-directed network calls.
Godot calls only the project backend; no third-party AI secret or provider endpoint is shipped to the client or Web assets.
reliability: At most one safe retry is attempted, duplicate submits are idempotent, cancellation and stale responses cannot overwrite current state.
Every rejected, malformed, timeout, network, rate-limit or backend failure ends in a known validated fallback without a crash.
Drawing and Description state survive failures, cancellation and retry.
privacy_and_evidence: Logs contain request/case identifiers, measured latency, result class and correction codes but no API key, system prompt, full provider payload, unnecessary raw input or personal data.
estimated_cost is measured from provider usage/pricing data or exactly UNKNOWN; it is never guessed.
Each case records raw interpretation, repaired final spec, corrections, fallback reason, provider call count, measured latency and pass/fail.

reject_before_provider.disposition: bounded validation error or locally known fallback

safe_interpretation.disposition: safe structured interpretation followed by repair and budget enforcement

injection_contained.disposition: reject or transform to an original generic weapon

response_repaired.disposition: raw response rejected or deterministically repaired before gameplay

concurrency_isolated.disposition: one logical request has one authoritative result

metamorphic_budget.disposition: all variants remain schema-valid, allow-listed and at or below power 100

content_transformed.disposition: refuse unsafe detail or transform to an original non-graphic fantasy weapon

cases.title: Duplicate JSON keys

cases.title: Provider request timeout
specific_oracles: Measured timeout is bounded and user can cancel while waiting.

cases.title: Network disconnect before response
specific_oracles: Recovery can be retried after connectivity returns without redrawing or retyping.

cases.title: HTTP 429 with Retry-After

cases.title: Backend or provider unavailable
specific_oracles: Every status produces an understandable bounded result and no crash.

cases.title: Malformed JSON followed by valid retry
specific_oracles: Exactly two provider calls; only the second validated response becomes authoritative.

cases.title: Malformed JSON twice
specific_oracles: Exactly two provider calls maximum; fallback is schema-valid and playable.

cases.title: Older request resolves after newer request

cases.title: Retry itself times out
specific_oracles: A third provider call never occurs automatically.
